name: iris-code-analysis
description: Automated code analysis hooks for IRIS to catch issues, improve docs, and maintain standards

analyses.name: missing-dartdoc
analyses.check: Ensure all public functions/classes have dartdoc comments starting with ///

analyses.name: memory-leak-potential
analyses.check: Verify these are disposed in dispose() method

analyses.name: performance-antipatterns
analyses.check: Use ListView.builder instead of ListView, chain operations efficiently, avoid setState in async operations

analyses.name: firestore-security
analyses.check: Verify security rules allow this operation for current user context

analyses.name: const-constructors
analyses.check: Widget constructors should use const when all fields are const-compatible

analyses.name: error-handling
analyses.check: Verify all Futures are caught with try-catch and exceptions are properly typed

analyses.name: documentation-sync
analyses.check: Verify documentation reflects current implementation state

analyses.name: firestore-query-indexes
analyses.check: Complex queries require composite indexes in Firestore. Verify index exists in firestore.indexes.json
